description: Override contract: column overrides to defined types over basic kinds (Label string, Count int64, Ratio float64, Flag bool, Blob []byte) and json.RawMessage on a text column, nullable columns read and written as pointers; seeded rows are read back and found by each value as a parameter, and rows written by exec and batch are found and listed. Reads go through sglScanOverride, and a text parameter whose Go type an override chose binds through sglDriverText, its bytes as text.
